This architecture exploits the properties of interaction nets, a new instruction set, to achieve a step-function gain in CPU performance that has long stagnated. The AI systems autonomously iterated over the compiler, ISA, architecture, microarchitecture, RTL, verification, and final GDS to discover novel hardware implementations and runtime features. This breakthrough has significant implications for the development of next-generation CPUs, which will likely undergo fundamental architectural shifts as AI systems become more capable.

The mixed base representation is a more elegant solution, as it allows for the carry of digits from one place to the next.
